document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    const btn = e.target.closest('.wpd-vote-up');
    if (!btn) return;

    const comment = btn.closest('[id^="comment-"]');
    if (!comment) return;

    const commentId = comment.id.replace('comment-', '');
    const key = 'wpd_voted_' + commentId;

    if (localStorage.getItem(key)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      return false;
    }

    // Allow first click, block next ones
    setTimeout(() => {
      localStorage.setItem(key, '1');
      btn.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      btn.style.opacity = '0.6';
    }, 500);

  }, true);

});
</script>

    if (localStorage.getItem(key)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      return false;

    // Allow first click, block next ones
    setTimeout(() => {
      localStorage.setItem(key, '1');
      btn.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      btn.style.opacity = '0.6';
    }, 500);

  }, true);

});

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    const btn = e.target.closest('.wpd-vote-up');
    if (!btn) return;

    const comment = btn.closest('[id^="comment-"]');
    if (!comment) return;

    const commentId = comment.id.replace('comment-', '');
    const key = 'wpd_voted_' + commentId;

    if (localStorage.getItem(key)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      return false;
    }

    // Allow first click, block next ones
    setTimeout(() => {
      localStorage.setItem(key, '1');
      btn.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      btn.style.opacity = '0.6';
    }, 500);

  }, true);

});

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    const btn = e.target.closest('.wpd-vote-up');
    if (!btn) return;

    const comment = btn.closest('[id^="comment-"]');
    if (!comment) return;

    const commentId = comment.id.replace('comment-', '');
    const key = 'wpd_voted_' + commentId;

    if (localStorage.getItem(key)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      return false;
    }

    // Allow first click, block next ones
    setTimeout(() => {
      localStorage.setItem(key, '1');
      btn.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      btn.style.opacity = '0.6';
    }, 500);

  }, true);

});
